text:
Maya L: Quick heads-up to eng + ops: we're scheduling retirement of the A100x preemptible dedicated pools. This is a planned retirement (not an incident). 45-day notice; hard cutoff 2025-09-30. Please start migrations this month.
Jordan M: Why are we retiring the preemptible fleet? Short: operational fragmentation + better economics on H200/A10G for preemptible workloads. Also maintenance windows are causing noisy neighbor issues on mixed pools.
Felix H: Are there per-region timelines or is it global on 2025-09-30?
Maya L: Global cutoff but staggered migration windows to avoid a big spike. Planned dry-run schedule (all times UTC):
- 2025-09-02 -> ap-southeast-1 dry-run (1h)
- 2025-09-09 -> eu-west-1 dry-run (2h)
- 2025-09-16 -> us-west-2 dry-run (2h)
Production redirections begin 2025-09-20 with rolling redirects and finished by 2025-09-30.
EngInfra: What tools will ops use to identify affected customers?
EngInfra: we've added a label and a query helper. Example:
```
# list affected instances across all regions
redctl instances list --filter "gpu=a100x-preemptible" --format csv | grep -v test-
```
Maya L: Good. Please ensure we include pinned_model and customer_tier fields in any exports.
Billing: How will billing be handled for leftover prepay/committed credits?
Billing: We'll auto-apply prorated credits to equivalent H200/A10G pool SKUs. Customers with contractual constraints will get outreach from Account Managers.
Felix H: Auto-migration risk? Will model perf/regression be an issue?
Maya L: Auto-migrate option exists but flagged as "best-effort". For models pinned to fp16/bfloat behavior, customers should opt for manual migration. We'll publish per-model compatibility notes.
Jordan M: Alerts & telemetry: new alert names: `dedicated.retirement.a100x.notice` (fires 30/14/7/1d), `dedicated.retirement.a100x.migration_errors` (if auto-migrate error rate >2%), and `dedicated.retirement.a100x.capacity_pressure` (if burst >20%). OpsBot will post weekly progress updates.
OpsBot: [automated] Created reminders: 30d, 14d, 7d, 1d; weekly summary on Mondays.
Maya L: Action items: EngInfra publish migration script and region charts (2 business days), SRE update runbooks & playbook (3 business days), Support send customer notice templates and console banner (EOD tomorrow), Billing publish credit mapping (2 business days).
Felix H: I'll coordinate the staging dry-run with infra and product; expect an invite.
Jordan M: If you find any workloads that cannot be safely migrated, tag them with `migration-exempt` and ping me.
Maya L: Thanks everyone — we'll track progress in this thread and post the migration doc here: <https://go.redwood.ai/internal/dedicated/a100x-retirement> :rocket:
